summary: Frontend-only verification of CoffeeModal scroll bug fix. Opened modals for espresso and latte, verified wheel scroll moves modal-scroll-area, all content (including Popularity bar) reachable, modal closes, and Lenis page scroll resumes. All regression checks pass (8 sections present, 20 coffee cards).

test_results.modal_close: OK - modal disappears after clicking modal-close-btn

context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal scroll fix verified via wheel events and programmatic scroll. data-lenis-prevent attribute is present on modal-scroll-area. Both mouse wheel and full scroll-to-bottom work; Popularity bar rendered at bottom for both tested coffees. Lenis page scroll resumes after modal close.
